principles.statement: A validity gate that counts array elements accepts shells: one heuristic whose every field is literal '...' passes a length check.
principles.rationale: Live-confirmed 2026-09-20: methodology 30420 persisted with a single all-'...' heuristic and was marked as COVERING a real gap, corrupting the gap queue. Length said valid; content said placeholder.

principles.statement: Small models parrot the prompt's own example values verbatim — example JSON in a prompt is bait that must be rejected at the persist gate.
principles.rationale: BitNet answered a deepening prompt with exactly ['specific detail 1', 'specific detail 2', 'specific detail 3'] — the example's own placeholders — and those reached the persist path as real children.

principles.statement: Retired/annotated garbage stays in the store and must be excluded by marker, not deletion — history is kept, influence is removed.
principles.rationale: Shell 30420 was annotated '[placeholder shell — retired]' rather than deleted (no silent drops) AND the coverage check learned to skip the marker, so the shell can never count as coverage again.

heuristics.name: Persisting any model-generated structured content (children, drafts, rules).
heuristics.description: Require at least one entry whose text fields are non-empty, non-ellipsis, and not a verbatim prompt-example echo. Count content, not entries.
heuristics.when_to_apply: Create/append paths fed by LLM output.

heuristics.name: A stored item is later found to be a placeholder shell.
heuristics.description: Annotate in place with an explicit marker, exclude the marker from ALL matching/coverage logic, and re-open any state that referenced it (with the reason recorded).

decision_rules.condition: A model draft's rules/heuristics fields contain '...', empty strings, or exact prompt-example echoes.
decision_rules.action: Discard the draft and keep the gap open — never persist, never mark covered.

decision_rules.condition: A previously-persisted item is identified as a placeholder shell.
decision_rules.action: Annotate it in place, exclude it from every matching path, and honestly re-open whatever state treated it as real.
